_doc: Tables that get a 'Show on map' link (spec: build/MAPLINK_SPEC.md; code: build/maplinks.py). Per table: book, table (id), part (index, default 0), label_col (default 0), columns (indices to send; default all but the label column), default (index into the sent columns), total_row (row index of the printed total, or null), date (table date, ISO-like: 1935, 1935-12, 1935-12-31), period (map period to show: 1930 or 1942), en_columns {col index: English}, col_meta {col index: {unit, kind: count|amount|rate|index|other, pc: per-capita view allowed, color: seq|div}}, row_ids {row index: place id} to override the automatic match, notes (short English notes for the map), view (named bounding box in maplinks.py; default japan). mult {payload column index: factor}: columns printed in thousands (1000), ten thousands (10000) or millions (1000000), sent multiplied out to full numbers (maplinks.apply_mult; decided per column in build/maplinks_units/).

notes: Geisha licensed in the Tokyo Metropolitan Police district, by prefecture of registered domicile (本籍). Rows for 朝鮮 and 樺太 are included; one row for 露西亞 (Russia, 2 persons) is not mapped.
Rates per 1,000 population for 1937; the 計 row is the national rate, not a sum of the prefectures.
